title: FinCEN's Residential Real Estate Reporting Rule Under Section 6403 With AI at the Title and Closing Table: The Nationwide Reporting Person Cascade, the Beneficial-Owner Capture, and What the December 1, 2025 Effective Date Actually Changed
summary: FinCEN's final rule at 31 CFR 1031.320, effective December 1, 2025, replaces the geographic-targeted Real Estate GTO regime with a nationwide reporting obligation on residential-real-estate transfers to legal entities and trusts. The rule uses a reporting-person cascade, requires beneficial-ownership capture on every covered transfer, and imposes a specific 30-day filing window. What the rule actually requires, how the AI agent participates in the closing workflow, and where the compliance risk lands for title, settlement, and mortgage professionals.
